label: FAKE: hand-written demo data, not real model output
purpose: Demo writer output. Deliberate faults: S4 'loads quickly' (no measure), S5 two goals, S6 'As a user', S7 invented '5 working days', N1 has no measure.

stories.goal: to report broken equipment from the ward PC
requests to be prioritised with life-support equipment first
each request routed to the right engineering team (imaging, lab, general)
to see open requests per team and how long each has been open
to be notified when the equipment I reported is fixed and track its repair
stories.benefit: I know when it can be used again

stories.goal: to sign in with my hospital login
stories.benefit: I don't need a separate password

stories.goal: to receive a monthly maintenance report within 5 working days of month end
stories.benefit: management sees how equipment is maintained

criteria.given: I am logged in on the ward PC
criteria.when: I submit a request with equipment, location and description
criteria.then: the request is saved and I see a reference number
the photo is stored with the request
the request is not saved and the missing field is shown
it appears in the imaging team's queue
the overview loads quickly and shows the number of open requests per team and the age of each request
I sign in with it and no separate password is required
the head of biomedical engineering receives it

open_questions.question: Who sets the priority: the nurse when reporting, or engineering on triage?
How is life-support equipment identified: from an asset list, or chosen by the nurse?
Is a request routed by equipment type, or is the team chosen by hand?
What counts as fixed: repaired, tested, or returned to the ward?
What format will the monthly report have? Ravi will send it.
What is the downtime target, and who decides it?

non_functional.statement: A downtime target for equipment was mentioned but not decided.
